validity_finding.summary: At scale 0.25 the first pass marks most of the pasted image region (prediction covers >60% of the pasted rectangle in 90/100 images; 32/100 at 0.35; 2/100 at 0.5). The second pass then largely undoes the synthetic shrink. Gains at 0.25 and 0.35 are therefore not an estimate of the gain on real small lesions.

other_findings: Zoom-out lowers unshifted DSC by about 1.3 pp and does not help at scale 2.0; it is dropped.
Scale 2.0 (large lesions): no gain from any non-oracle config; oracle gain 1.4 pp. The large-lesion weakness is not addressed.
Oracle windows recover 89-90 DSC at every shrink level: localisation by the first pass is the limiting factor.
decision: Accepted as executed. The pre-set gate is passed; the size of the effect must come from the one-time locked Test confirmation.
